signals.method: JPEG-ghost sweep: re-encode q50–q95, locate MSE minimum
signals.note: Locates the JPEG quality at which reconstruction error is minimised. A minimum well below q95 indicates the content was compressed before this copy was made.

signals.name: DCT first-digit distribution
signals.method: 8×8 block DCT, AC first-digit distribution, χ² vs Benford
signals.note: Natural, singly-compressed imagery follows Benford's law closely. Larger χ² distance indicates processing history or synthesis.

signals.name: Sensor-noise residual
signals.note: Camera capture leaves per-pixel sensor noise. Low and spatially uniform residual is consistent with smoothing, upscaling or synthesis — but also with heavy compression.

signals.name: High-frequency energy
signals.note: Upscaled or generated content is typically deficient in high spatial frequency relative to native capture at the same resolution.

signals.name: Compression blockiness
signals.method: 8-px grid boundary gradient energy vs off-grid
signals.note: Measures energy on the 8-pixel JPEG grid. Elevated values indicate strong or repeated compression rather than manipulation on its own.

signals.name: Temporal continuity
signals.note: Consistency of change between sampled keyframes. A low value is a counter-indicator: it does not corroborate manipulation.

signals.name: Metadata & encoder coherence
signals.note: Structural observations from the container/EXIF. Missing metadata is recorded as an absence and is never scored as proof of manipulation.

signals.name: AI-synthetic image signal
signals.method: Frame-level AI-synthetic image signal (AI-image-detector (Swin-ViT)); median of per-frame model scores
signals.note: Model AI-synthetic score: 79.67%. Real neural model inference (not fabricated). Decision-support signal only: does not by itself establish authenticity or manipulation. Model is designed primarily for artistic AI imagery and is not a deepfake photo detector.

signals.name: Provenance (C2PA / Content Credentials)
signals.note: Signature mathematically valid, but signing certificate (Unknown Signer) is not linked to any local offline trust anchor.
